name: j-aeneas
style: Adult male documentary narrator, warm and grounded, American English. Curious and quick on the opening question, clear and steady through the journey; place names and numbers a beat slower. No hype, no shouting. The last line is a real question, left hanging.

lines.text: Why did Aeneas wander for seven years, when Italy was only a few weeks' sail from Troy?
The answer is on this route.
It begins in Troy, in flames, on the coast of modern Turkey.
First stop: Thrace, where a bleeding myrtle warns him to leave.
On Delos, Apollo's oracle tells him: seek your ancient mother.
His father reads it as Crete.
Then a plague drives them out.
So which mother did the god mean?
